reports.summary:
fguzg h s...Continue the 18-phase authentication and credential-management plan on GlobyEdu OS. Password hashing, temporary passwords, Super Admin credential management, and audit logging are already implemented and tested (per earlier phases). 

Now focus specifically on:
1. PHASE 10 — Rate limiting: inspect whether login endpoints already have brute-force protection. If not, add it (reuse any existing rate-limiting library/middleware if present).
2. PHASE 9 — Password reset/recovery: confirm change-password (self-service) and admin-reset (Super Admin resetting another user's password) both work correctly and are separate flows. If full self-service account recovery (forgot password via email) isn't supported due to missing production email infrastructure, report that clearly as NOT SUPPORTED — REQUIRES PRODUCTION EMAIL/RECOVERY INFRASTRUCTURE rather than faking it.
3. PHASE 11 — Authorization: test that Super Admin, School Authority, Teacher, and Student roles are all enforced on the backend, not just hidden in the frontend UI. Try bypassing via direct API calls with a mismatched role/tenant and confirm requests are rejected.

Run focused tests for each, then the full suite and build. Report PASS/FAIL/NOT SUPPORTED for each of the three items — don't claim PASS for anything not actually tested.
